name: Bitwarden API Patterns
description: Bitwarden MCP fundamentals: the organization API key passed through Conduit as X-Bitwarden-Client-Id / X-Bitwarden-Client-Secret / X-Bitwarden-Region, the 12 read-only tools and which one is admin-gated, full-list responses versus the paged event log, response truncation, the member role and status enums, error and rate-limit handling, and what the Public API can never return. Every other Bitwarden skill assumes these patterns.
